canonical_project: Nickelsdorf large data center (up to 50 ha)
notes: ORF Burgenland (2026-08-03): speculation/talks about a datacenter up to 50 ha near Nickelsdorf on land owned by the Burgenland economic agency; Landesholding spokesman says talks with various interested parties are ongoing but no imminent construction; Netz Burgenland confirms multiple grid-connection inquiries but declines details for regulatory reasons; mayor informed mid-August 2026.
